notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 7 or greater.
description:
Activate Kiora by paying {1} due to Agatha, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying.
When the Dragon enters, Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
